name: Azariah (son of Obed)
title: Military commander who assisted Jehoiada
summary: Azariah, son of Obed, was one of the commanders who made a covenant with the priest Jehoiada to install the young king Joash and end Queen Athaliah's reign.

keyEvents.title: Helping Jehoiada Install Joash
keyEvents.description: Azariah, son of Obed, was among the commanders who made a covenant with Jehoiada to make Joash king.
